description: Places that must have a band of the tree of humankind from a year on (spec sites.md section 4.1): the build brings the nearest band there and holds it, and fails if it cannot.

anchors.source: Schmidt 2010, Göbekli Tepe – the Stone Age sanctuaries, Documenta Praehistorica 37

anchors.de: Die gemalte Geschichte von Leang Karampuang
anchors.source: Oktaviana, A. A. et al. 2024, Narrative cave art in Indonesia by 51,200 years ago, Nature 631, 814-818

anchors.en: The paintings of the Chauvet Cave

anchors.en: The paintings of the Lascaux Cave
